story.title: Meet the Croc-Wolf of the Magma Fields
story.signature_move: It packs the stamina of a chasing wolf and the crushing death roll of an ancient crocodile.
story.hybrid_look: A massive, terrifying apex predator with a muscular wolf body covered in armored obsidian crocodile scales, glowing amber eyes, and deep thermal burn scars.

sentences.text: This nightmare creature melts armor with a single bite.
sentences.image: jagged volcanic peaks exploding with fountains of glowing molten rock and dark ash

sentences.text: Meet the imaginary Magma Lupusuchus, born from the strength of a wolf and the scales of a crocodile.
sentences.image: steaming rivers of bright orange lava cutting through black jagged basalt stone fields

sentences.text: It stalks the steep slopes of the smoking caldera.
sentences.image: massive black volcano cones venting thick toxic white clouds into the dark sky

sentences.text: To cross boiling mud pits, it uses the sprawling belly crawl of a cold-blooded hunter.
sentences.image: bubbling pools of grey volcanic mud popping with sulfur gas under a red haze

sentences.text: It hunts the fleet-footed obsidian goat across treacherous ash plains.
sentences.image: endless sweeping plains of deep black volcanic ash whipped by hot thermal winds

sentences.text: Blending wolf endurance with a crushing crocodile death roll, it traps its prey against the lava flow.
sentences.image: narrow canyon walls glowing intensely from a slow creeping river of red fire

sentences.text: Yet this fiery beast panics completely in heavy rainstorms.
sentences.image: massive storm clouds unleashing a torrential downpour over smoking black rock fields

sentences.text: What should I combine next? Tell me in the comments.
sentences.image: dark brooding volcanic horizon glowing faintly with dying embers at dusk
